DIAGNOSIS READY: Extrahepatic Cholestasis secondary to Pancreatic Adenocarcinoma.

The clinical picture of painless jaundice, pruritus, weight loss, pale stools, and dark urine in a 72-year-old male is highly suggestive of a malignancy causing biliary obstruction, likely at the head of the pancreas. I will now request imaging to confirm the location and nature of the obstruction.
